thread:
hana_sales: Quick sync — VertexCorp POC is ready to sign but procurement pushed a redline. Main asks: customer-controlled HSM (BYOK), strict EU-only processing, 99.9% SLA with punitive credits, and CFO wants net-60 + PO on the invoice. Can we deliver or need to push back?

omar_legal: Please drop their redline here. We need exact clause text to craft a narrow counter. Also flag any unlimited liability language.

hana_sales: Uploaded redline: https://files.redwood/proc/vertex_redline_v2.pdf. They replaced our KMS sentence with: "Customer shall exclusively hold and manage encryption keys in Customer HSMs, and Redwood shall not have access." They also added EU data residency clause: "All customer data shall at all times be stored and processed only within EU territories."

leo_ops: Short answer: Hosted tier cannot meet exclusive customer HSM custody. Options: (1) Dedicated with HSM gateway + attestation, (2) Private deployment. EU-only residency is fine if we deploy in EU region and hard-block egress. Both add operational steps.

nina_eng: Tech detail: BYOK + HSM attestation needs either customer-managed CloudHSM or Private HSM appliance. For Dedicated we can route KMS calls through an HSM gateway; attestation/reporting will require additional onboarding hooks. Estimate timeline: Dedicated + HSM gateway ~2-3 weeks; Private ~4-6 weeks depending on infra and network approvals.

tess_finance: Net-60 is outside standard 30-day net terms. We occasionally approve net-60 for strategic accounts with credit check & finance lead sign-off. PO on invoice is acceptable; we'll add PO# field.

omar_legal: Regarding SLA credits — we should refuse punitive/uncapped credits. Propose a capped credit scheme: e.g., 5% monthly credit per severe outage after third occurrence per quarter, capped at 15% monthly. I'll draft a clause that satisfies procurement but protects us.

hana_sales: They insisted on sequential signing: legal -> CFO. Also want the order form to list the POC discount line and final post-POC rates.

docusign_bot: DocuSign: sequential signing supported. Template ID: tpl_99823. Fields available: signer_order, PO_number, billing_contact, invoice_terms.

leo_ops: Operational checklist items if we accept Dedicated w/ HSM: 1) EU cluster provisioning, 2) HSM gateway config, 3) egress firewall rules, 4) onboarding attestation runbook, 5) SOC+pen test review scheduling. Expect ~1 week after infra ready to complete runbook items.

nina_eng: I'll prep the HSM attestation checklist and sample attestation report format. Will also note any telemetry we need for audits.

tess_finance: To fast-track net-60, we need an approved credit application and risk sign-off. Hana, can you ask them to complete our credit form today? Link: https://payments.redwood/credit-form

hana_sales: Sent procurement contact jenny.proc@vertexcorp the credit form and the updated POC order form draft. Also asked them to confirm whether Dedicated is acceptable or if they insist on Private.

omar_legal: I'll prepare three redline options: (A) Accept BYOK with attestation + limited access language (Dedicated ok), (B) Private-only with full BYOK, (C) standard Redwood KMS with SOC2 attestations (fallback). Will post redlines in ~18 hours.

leo_ops: If we go Private, we need network diagrams and an onsite checklist. That will add calendar time. Please clarify customer timeline expectation.

hana_sales: Customer wants POC start within 2 weeks. They're leaning Dedicated to avoid full Private procurement.

tess_finance: If they can provide credit info quickly and accept the capped SLA_credit, I can escalate net-60 approval to finance lead.

nina_eng: FYI — certain model quantization/throughput profiles change when HSM gateway adds latency. I'll run a perf check during staging; may require small config tweak.

hana_sales: Plan: (1) Omar posts redline draft, (2) Finance requests credit form completion, (3) Ops prepares onboarding checklist & timeline, (4) I'll coordinate DocuSign sequential signers and ensure PO field present. Will update thread once procurement replies. :slightly_smiling_face:

omar_legal: One more: include a clause requiring customer to provide HSM attestation report signed by their security officer; Redwood retains right to suspend access if attestation fails. Keeps us safe.

hana_sales: Noted. Thanks all — looping in jenny.proc@vertexcorp now.
